templates.title: Review a drink
templates.summary: One coffee, tea or cold drink from the menu: the pour, the order, the first sip and whether it is worth the price.

steps.title: Order
steps.position: At the counter, beside the barista
steps.direction: Film over your shoulder toward the barista or the menu board as you order, and say the drink's name.
steps.prompter: Asked the barista what to get, and this is the one.

captions.script: Asked the barista what to get, and this is the one.
My order today, the drink people keep posting from here.

steps.line: Getting the {menuItem.name}. The barista says it's their best.
steps.caption: Ordered: {menuItem.name}
steps.idea: Where you order, with the menu or the barista in view.

steps.title: The pour
steps.position: Above the cup on the counter
steps.direction: Phone straight above the cup. Film the pour, the latte art, or the ice and colour as it is stirred, and move in a little.

captions.script: Watch this pour. This is the drink I came for.
Is this drink worth the price? Let's find out together.

steps.line: Watching them make the {menuItem.name}. Look at that pour.
steps.caption: {menuItem.name}
steps.idea: Your drink being made, the pour or the ice close up.

templates.title: Review a pastry or dessert

steps.line: Picking the {menuItem.name} from the case.

templates.title: Review a spread

dish.reads: The dish grows from a close-up until the sauce or steam fills the frame; a whip off it lands on the door outside.

arrive.reads: The door grows as we walk straight at it until it fills the frame; cut to the menu board.

order.reads: The board's columns slide past at one even pace while the dish is named; cut to the first bite.

bite.reads: The fork rises from the plate toward the lens and the face grows as the creator leans in to bite; cut back to arm's length.

verdict.reads: Arm's length, plate and face in frame, held still while the verdict and price land.

pour.reads: From above, the cup grows until the pour or the art fills the frame; match-cut on the cup as it is handed over the counter.

order.reads: Over the shoulder at the counter, the barista hands the cup across while the creator names it; cut to the cup alone on the table.

cup.reads: At cup height, the camera circles so the handle or straw comes around and the far side of the cup appears; cut to the creator.

sip.reads: The cup rises to the creator's mouth and the face grows slightly as they lean in for the sip; cut back to arm's length.

verdict.reads: Arm's length, cup and room behind, held still for the price and the verdict.

build.reads: From the bar edge the glass grows as it fills and the head settles; match-cut on the full glass lifted against the light.

glass.reads: At eye level the glass glows against the bar lights, then the view tilts down with it as it lands on the bar top; cut to the creator.

sip.reads: The creator lifts the glass and leans in to sip, the face growing in frame; cut back to arm's length.

verdict.reads: Arm's length with the taps behind, held still for the price and the happy hour.

case.reads: At shelf height the case fills the frame, then the camera moves in on one pastry until it fills the frame; the next shot starts filled with it on the plate.

break.reads: The pastry fills the frame as it is torn open and the inside grows toward the lens; cut to the creator taking a bite.

taste.reads: The pastry rises to the creator's mouth and the face grows as they lean in; cut back to arm's length.

verdict.reads: Arm's length with the plate, held still for the price and the tip.

window.reads: The counter or truck grows as the creator walks up to the window; a whip down lands on the food in their hands.

cut.reads: Low and close, the two halves come apart toward the lens and the filling grows until it fills the frame; cut to the creator lifting it.

bite.reads: Two hands lift it to the creator's mouth and the face grows with the bite; cut back to arm's length.

verdict.reads: Arm's length with the counter or truck behind, held still for the price.

spread.reads: From straight above one dish, the camera rises and the rest of the table appears around it until the whole spread fills the frame; cut low to the grill.

action.reads: At grill height the meat hits the heat and grows in frame; the next shot starts on it and pulls back to show the table.

how.reads: Starting on the meat on the grill, the camera eases back until the creator, the grill and the whole table are in frame as they explain how it works; cut to the front camera.

bite.reads: The first piece rises from the grill to the creator's mouth and the face grows; cut back to arm's length.

verdict.reads: Arm's length from slightly above, table and friends in frame, held for the price per person.

arrive.reads: The door grows as we walk straight at it until it fills the frame; a whip off it lands on the first taste.

dish.reads: What was ordered grows from a close-up until the steam, sauce or foam fills the frame; a whip off it lands on the door outside.

bite.reads: The first bite or sip rises toward the lens and the face grows as the creator leans in; cut back to arm's length.

verdict.reads: Arm's length, what was ordered and the face in frame, held still while the verdict lands.
